args.body:
File: src/config.ts

Validate the TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES configuration parsing to reject non-integer strings like "12h" instead of allowing Number.parseInt to silently truncate them, preventing unexpected token expiration times.
args.title: Fix TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES parsing of non-integer time strings in src/config.ts

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/config.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Setting TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES=12h passes Number.parseInt('12h', 10) in src/config.ts which parses as 12 instead of validating or throwing an error, causing unexpected token expiration after 12 minutes.

File: src/api/health.ts

Clarify or adjust the status code mapping in the health check endpoint so that degraded status either returns an appropriate status code or is documented as intentionally returning HTTP 200.
args.title: Clarify or adjust HTTP status code for degraded health check

args.body:
label: question
file: src/api/health.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

src/api/health.ts explicitly sets status 200 when checks.status is 'degraded' (status === 'down' ? 503 : 200), meaning degraded returns HTTP 200.

args.title: Correct Accept-Language q-value parsing in pickLocale
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

Update pickLocale in src/i18n/index.ts to correctly parse Accept-Language q-values (quality values) so that locales with higher quality values are correctly preferred over those that appear earlier in the header with lower quality values.

label: bug
file: src/i18n/index.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

src/i18n/index.ts implements pickLocale by splitting by comma and ignoring q-values, returning the first supported language in header order, which causes `en;q=0.3, fr-FR;q=0.9` to return English instead of French.
